source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 16: Reported Speech

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: She said that she ___ tired of inequality.
starter.explanation_long: Reported speech: said + lùi 1 bậc. is → was.

starter.stem: He told me that he ___ help the community project.
starter.explanation_long: Reported: told + lùi thì. will → would.

starter.stem: They said they ___ already donated to the charity.
starter.explanation_long: Reported: said + lùi. have donated → had donated.

starter.stem: Direct: 'I will fight for justice.' → She said she ___ fight for justice.
starter.explanation_long: Reported: pronoun I → she. will → would.

starter.stem: The report stated that poverty ___ increasing worldwide.
starter.explanation_long: Reported: stated (past) → is increasing → was increasing.
starter.feedback_wrong: Reported verb in past → lùi thì.

starter.stem: 'We need more funding.' → They said they ___ more funding.
starter.explanation_long: Reported: said → need → needed. We → they.

starter.stem: 'The situation is getting worse.' → He said the situation ___ getting worse.
She ___ me that the project had been cancelled.
starter.explanation_short: told + me (có tân ngữ). said không có tân ngữ.
starter.distractor_note: obvious: said (cần 'said to me' hoặc 'said that')

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'He said that he will attend the global summit next month.'
options: Sai: will → would (reported speech lùi thì)
starter.correct_answer: Sai: will → would (reported speech lùi thì)

starter.stem: The leader said that the crisis ___ urgent attention.

build_up.stem: The spokesperson announced that the organization ___ launching a new initiative.
build_up.explanation_long: Reported: announced (past) → is launching → was launching.

build_up.stem: She claimed that the government ___ enough to address climate change.
build_up.explanation_short: claimed → lùi thì: has not done → had not done.
build_up.explanation_long: Reported: claimed → Present Perfect → Past Perfect.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ claimed → has not → had not done
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: did not do (lùi từ does)

build_up.stem: He asked me where the refugee camp ___.
build_up.explanation_short: asked → lùi thì: is → was. Câu hỏi gián tiếp.
build_up.explanation_long: Reported question: asked + where + S + V (không đảo). is → was.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Reported question: asked where + S + was
build_up.feedback_wrong: asked + Wh + S + V (word order bình thường).

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'She asked me where did the conference take place.'
options: Sai: where did → where the conference took (không đảo trong reported)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: where did → where the conference took (không đảo trong reported)
build_up.explanation_short: Reported question: S + V (không đảo): where the conference took place.
build_up.explanation_long: Reported question KHÔNG đảo: asked + Wh + S + V. Không dùng did/does/do.
build_up.ielts_tip: Reported: asked where S + V (no inversion).

build_up.stem: The ambassador ___ that immediate action was needed to resolve the crisis.
build_up.explanation_short: said + that (không tân ngữ). told + object + that.
build_up.explanation_long: said + that clause (no object). told + someone + that clause.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The report stated that global poverty is declining, but inequality is rising.'
options: Câu đúng — có thể giữ present khi sự thật vẫn đúng (reporting facts)
build_up.correct_answer: Câu đúng — có thể giữ present khi sự thật vẫn đúng (reporting facts)
build_up.explanation_short: Ngoại lệ: general truth/facts vẫn đúng → có thể giữ present.
build_up.explanation_long: Khi reported fact vẫn đúng ở hiện tại → CÓ THỂ giữ present tense. Đây là ngoại lệ cho reported speech.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Facts vẫn đúng → có thể giữ present!
build_up.feedback_wrong: General truth/ongoing fact → present OK trong reported.
build_up.ielts_tip: Exception: facts still true → present OK.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option B (is→was cũng đúng nhưng không bắt buộc)

build_up.stem: 'Donate to the cause!' → She urged everyone ___ to the cause.
build_up.explanation_short: Reported imperative: urged + object + to V.
build_up.explanation_long: Reported imperative: V (command) → to V. urged everyone to donate.
build_up.ielts_tip: Imperative → to V: urged/told/asked to V.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'I said that I can solve the problem by yourself.'
options: Sai: yourself → myself (pronoun phải nhất quán với I)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: yourself → myself (pronoun phải nhất quán với I)
build_up.explanation_short: I → myself (không yourself). Pronoun phải nhất quán.
build_up.explanation_long: I → myself. You → yourself. Phải nhất quán ngôi.
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: option C (can→could cũng có thể cần sửa)

build_up.stem: The expert warned that if emissions ___ reduced, temperatures would rise sharply.
build_up.explanation_short: warned → lùi thì: are not → were not.
build_up.explanation_long: Reported: warned → are not → were not. Conditional trong reported speech.

build_up.stem: The president declared that the country ___ take a leading role in climate negotiations.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The minister stated that the government will implement new policies to combat poverty and that they are committed to change.'
options: the government will implement new policies
challenge.correct_answer: the government will implement new policies
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'stated' (past) → 'will implement' → 'would implement'. Lớp 2: 'are committed' → 'were committed'. Cả B và D sai, B trước.
challenge.feedback_wrong: stated → lùi thì: will → would, are → were.
challenge.ielts_tip: Reported: stated → lùi tất cả thì.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (are→were) cũng cần sửa

challenge.stem:
Chọn câu reported speech CHUẨN NHẤT:
Direct: 'We have made significant progress in reducing poverty,' the UN Secretary said.
options: The UN Secretary said that they have made significant progress in reducing poverty.
The UN Secretary said that they had made significant progress in reducing poverty.
The UN Secretary said that we have made significant progress.
The UN Secretary said that they has made significant progress.
challenge.correct_answer: The UN Secretary said that they had made significant progress in reducing poverty.
challenge.explanation_short: said → have made → had made. we → they.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'have made' → 'had made' (Present Perfect → Past Perfect). Lớp 2: 'we' → 'they'. Lớp 3: Option A không lùi thì. Option C không đổi pronoun.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 have made → had made + we → they = chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Reported: have V3 → had V3. we → they.
challenge.ielts_tip: Present Perfect → Past Perfect trong reported.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A giữ present perfect (informal OK nhưng kém chuẩn)

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The journalist asked why did the government fail to address the humanitarian crisis in time.'
challenge.explanation_short: Reported question: KHÔNG đảo. asked why the government had failed.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: Reported question → word order bình thường: asked why the government HAD FAILED (không did...fail). Lớp 2: Lùi thì: fail → had failed.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 Reported question: KHÔNG đảo + lùi thì!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Reported Q: Wh + S + V (no inversion). + lùi thì.

challenge.stem:
Chọn câu reported speech CHUẨN NHẤT:
Direct: 'You must act now!' the activist told the crowd.
options: The activist told the crowd that they must act immediately.
The activist told the crowd that they had to act immediately.
The activist urged the crowd to act immediately.
The activist told the crowd they must to act immediately.
challenge.correct_answer: The activist urged the crowd to act immediately.
challenge.explanation_short: urged + to V = reported imperative chuẩn formal.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'urged the crowd to act' = reported imperative chuẩn. Lớp 2: Option B (had to) cũng đúng nhưng kém powerful. Option D 'must to' = sai.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 urged + to V = reported imperative chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: urged/told + object + to V = reported imperative.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (had to) cũng acceptable

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'The expert ___ [A] that poverty ___ [B] a major threat and that immediate action ___ [C] necessary.'
challenge.explanation_short: said + that (no object). was + was (nhất quán lùi thì).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'said + that' (no object) → đúng. Lớp 2: 'was' + 'was' = nhất quán lùi thì. Lớp 3: Option B 'told' cần object (told someone).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 said + was + was = nhất quán chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: said + that. Nhất quán lùi thì.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The researcher reported that the findings shows a clear link between poverty and lack of education, which has been documented extensively.'
options: the findings shows a clear link
between poverty and lack of education
challenge.correct_answer: the findings shows a clear link
challenge.explanation_short: findings (plural) → show (không shows). + shows → showed (lùi thì).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'findings' = plural → 'show' (không 'shows'). Lớp 2: reported → lùi thì: show → showed. Lớp 3: 'has been' cũng nên lùi thành 'had been'.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (has→had) cũng cần sửa

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: infectious diseases remain a significant threat in developing nations
The WHO report said that infectious diseases remains a significant threat.
The WHO reported that infectious diseases are remaining a threat.
diseases remains a threat to developing nations.
challenge.correct_answer: According to the WHO report, infectious diseases remain a significant threat in developing nations, where healthcare infrastructure is inadequate.
challenge.explanation_short: According to = present fact. remain (plural) = đúng.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'According to' = reporting phrase → có thể giữ present (facts). Lớp 2: 'remain' (plural agree). Lớp 3: 'where' = relative clause cho place. Lớp 4: Option B 'remains' = sai (plural). Option C 'are remaining' = unnecessary continuous.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 According to + present facts = academic chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: According to + present tense for ongoing facts.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (remains) sai plural agreement

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The ambassador told that his country would support the resolution and that they had already begun preparations.'
options: his country would support the resolution
challenge.explanation_short: told cần object: told US/THEM that (không told that).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'told that' → 'told us/them that' hoặc 'said that' (told cần object). Lớp 2: 'would support' + 'had begun' = đúng tense backshift.
challenge.feedback_wrong: told + object + that. said + that (no object).

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 2: 'Kể lại lời khuyên ai đó đã cho bạn.' — Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: My teacher said me that I should study harder for the IELTS exam.
My teacher told me that I should focus more on my writing skills and practice regularly.
My teacher told that I should study harder.
My teacher said to me I should to study.
challenge.correct_answer: My teacher told me that I should focus more on my writing skills and practice regularly.
challenge.explanation_short: told me + that + should = reported advice chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'told me that I should' = reported advice chuẩn. Lớp 2: 'focus more on... and practice regularly' = chi tiết, tự nhiên. Lớp 3: Option A 'said me' = sai (said to me). Option C 'told that' thiếu object.
challenge.ielts_tip: Speaking: told me that I should = reported advice.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (said me) sai cấu trúc

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'The UN [A] told that poverty is declining, experts [B] said that they has made progress, and leaders [C] claimed that the world will achieve the SDGs by 2030.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] told that → told us that / said that. [B] has → had (lùi thì + plural). [C] will → would (lùi thì).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'told that' → 'told us that' hoặc 'said that' (told cần object). Lớp 2: [B] 'they has' → 'they had' (plural: have→had, không has). Lớp 3: [C] 'claimed + will' → 'claimed + would' (lùi thì).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] said that / told us that | [B] they had made | [C] would achieve!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] told + object. [B] they had (plural + lùi). [C] would (lùi will).
challenge.ielts_tip: Reported: told + object. Subject-verb agreement. Tense backshift.
